entities.name: Fujiwara no Tadahira
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Fujiwara no Tadahira  was a Japanese statesman, courtier and politician during the Heian period. He is also known as Teishin-Kō (貞信公) or Ko-ichijō Dono (小一条殿) or Ko-ichijō daijō-daijin.
